$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：破軍獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.126。

rules.text: 對宮的廉貞化忌，你的破軍基本上帶頑嚚的性質：破壞力大、創造力弱；有魁鉞、左右或祿存，可以調和。
rules.en: Lian Zhen opposite you is transformed by Ji, which gives your Po Jun a basically stubborn streak: much destructive force, little creative force; Kui, Yue, Zuo, You or Lu Cun can temper it.

rules.text: 文曲化忌同宮或對照，成破軍暗曜，其實也是頑嚚。
rules.en: Wen Qu transformed by Ji in your palace or opposite forms the 'darkened Po Jun', which is really just stubbornness.

rules.text: 你的破軍化祿，為人果敢。
rules.en: Your Po Jun is transformed by Lu, which makes you decisive.

rules.text: 你的破軍化權，為人果敢。
rules.en: Your Po Jun is transformed by Quan, which makes you decisive.
